description: A matte-black flash drive the size of a thumbnail, its casing veined with a single hairline of cold green light that pulses like it's breathing. Etched down one side in micro-type: SPECTER // GHOST-SIG FIRMWARE. The USB connector is scuffed from a dozen ports it was never meant to see. Slot it into your tablet and `use` it — a flasher boots, bypasses the tablet's signature check, and writes SPECTER to ROM. One-shot: the drive dies with the install.
name: SPECTER Firmware Drive
